changelog.github_title: plagTalk v0.2.0 - Voice Routing & Platform Overhaul
notes: ElevenLabs TTS engine support via user API key.
Audio output device picker — route TTS to any output including VB-Audio Virtual Cable for OBS capture.
Channel Points (Twitch) redemptions with per-title voice rules dialog.
Per-event voice override on every event row.
Per-platform independent chat settings (Twitch, TikTok, YouTube, Kick each have separate toggles and templates).
Voice per Platform redesign with colored platform labels and per-row randomize / reset buttons.
Auto-save across all settings pages with animated Saved confirmation — Save buttons removed.
Bot command filter (ignore messages starting with ! by default).
User whitelist for chat TTS — restrict chat reading to listed usernames.
WheelBlocker fix — scroll wheel no longer accidentally changes spinboxes or combo boxes.
Initial release of plagTalk.
Windows SAPI, Google Cloud TTS, and ElevenLabs support.
Twitch, TikTok, YouTube, and Kick platform integrations.
Per-event voice templates with token system.
Voice per username and per platform overrides.
User blocklist and whitelist for chat TTS.
TTS command mode (!tts prefix).
Voice randomization and pool system.
Platform visibility toggles.
Events accordion sidebar with per-platform event pages.
